# Local chat dependencies

- marked 18.0.14: npm package `marked`, `lib/marked.umd.js` (MIT).
- DOMPurify 3.4.16: npm package `dompurify`, `dist/purify.min.js` (Apache-2.0 OR MPL-2.0).

Bundled locally so chat formatting does not require a CDN connection. Corresponding licenses are included here. Only allowlisted inert formatting is rendered from model output.
